law: Accept defined semantics, provide one primary exact repair, or state a missing capability with the closest supported alternative.

decisions.rationale: Typed mutation gains no safety from spelling out every addition.
Existing typed equality already excludes coercion; add no identity domain.
Keep associated functions and name the exact native call.
Reuse reflected constructor/type authority, not a second runtime.
Bind receiver/index once and spell out the indexed update.

decisions.instinct: Immutable records and closed object values
decisions.rationale: Preserve value identity/layout; update through with.
One explicit absence model with typed construction and access.
Keep ownership visible; no implicit ambient capture.
Concrete values or constrained generics preserve layout and static authority.
CLR alternatives exist; native ordered hash/Option semantics still require a shared owner.
Specify the same result in static evaluation, checked C# hosts, and JavaScript.
Scalar column hot loops need no forced row materialization.
